strings.name: A. R. Rahman
strings.summary: Rahman moved from keyboards and advertising into film scoring, beginning a long collaboration with Mani Ratnam on Roja in 1992. He blends South Asian music, electronics, orchestra and voices across Hindi cinema, musicals and international work. Slumdog Millionaire brought two Oscars, with the song prize shared with its lyricist. He also founded a conservatory.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through Indian film scores and international collaboration, he blends traditional, electronic and orchestral sounds, advancing the global reach of Indian music production.
